**Preferred gene-related syndrome label**
Hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia, familial 3

**Synonyms**
GCK-related hyperinsulinism

**Parent term (use [OLS](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols/ontologies/mondo), or your favorite ontology browser)**
https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/ontologies/mondo/classes/http%253A%252F%252Fpurl.obolibrary.org%252Fobo%252FMONDO_0017182 MONDO:0017182 familial hyperinsulinism

**Definition**
Familial hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia 3 (FHH3) is an autosomal dominant form of congenital hyperinsulinism due to gain-of-function mutations in glucokinase (GCK), which lower the glucose threshold for insulin secretion. 


**Definition source (Please give PubMed ID, if applicable, in format PMID:#######)
PMIDs: 15277402, 34680961,24890200

**Children terms (if applicable)** Should any existing terms be re-classified as children underneath this new proposed term? 
N/A

comments.body: Hello, our GCEP is wondering when this request might be completed?

@elmacke, thank you for submitting the ticket and your patience. 

There is an existing Mondo term MONDO:0011236 'hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia due to glucokinase deficiency' that has the same concept and gene association as the request term. Based on OMIM's update and your request, MONDO:0011236 has been updated to be 'hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia, familial, 3'. 'GCK-related hyperinsulinism' has been added as synonym.

A PR has been created for the changes and it will be reviewed soon. 

Thanks.

@elmacke  @MeeSiing  this is the same concept but we would prefer the term GCK-related hyperinsulinism as the primary term in keeping with updated recommended nomenclature (Toni Pollin, Co-Chair, ClinGen Monogenic Diabetes Gene Curation Expert Panel)
